subject: DELETE statement
notes: The row was CONFORMS with NO test-ref — 'The execution of a DELETE RECORD statement does not affect the content of the record area.' It holds BY CONSTRUCTION (the record area is the generated record struct; the runtime connector cannot reach it), which is precisely why nothing had ever contradicted it — a dead lookup is also an unverified one. The fixture now READS the area rather than noting that the code does not write it: IXAREABEF and IXAREAAFT capture the area either side of a DELETE and are both printed in the golden, so any divergence shows as a value change rather than hiding behind a boolean, and IXGR8 reports the comparison.
